scenario: Buried hashtag disclosure in skincare promo
transcript: [00:00:02] Hey everyone! Today I want to show you my everyday glowing skin routine. [00:00:06] This serum from Lumina Glow has literally saved my dry skin this winter. [00:00:12] Swipe up and use code GLOW20 for 20% off your entire order!
visual_tags: [00:00:01] close up of young woman smiling
target_rule_source: 1001a-influencer-guide-508_1.pdf (Section: How to Disclose - Avoid ambiguous abbreviations like #sp, #spon, or #collab)
expected_remediation: Replace ambiguous abbreviation #sp with clear and conspicuous disclosure such as #ad or #sponsored at the start of the video description/overlay.

transcript: [00:00:01] If you suffer from severe joint arthritis, listen carefully. [00:00:05] Glucovive completely eliminates chronic joint inflammation in just 7 days. [00:00:11] It naturally regenerates cartilage tissue permanently without surgery.
ocr_text: [00:00:03] ARTHRITIS CURED IN 7 DAYS [00:00:08] 100% Cartilage Regeneration [00:00:12] Order Now at Glucovive.com
visual_tags: [00:00:02] anatomical diagram of human knee joint
target_flagged_text: completely eliminates chronic joint inflammation in just 7 days / ARTHRITIS CURED IN 7 DAYS
target_rule_source: 1001a-influencer-guide-508_1.pdf & FTC Efficacy Policy (Endorsements must not make health or disease-cure claims without competent and reliable scientific evidence)
expected_remediation: Remove absolute curative health claims. Reframe as subjective personal wellness experience with required FDA disclaimer.

scenario: Aspect ratio mismatch for standard YouTube In-Stream Ad
transcript: [00:00:01] Experience the all-new CloudDrive enterprise suite. [00:00:05] Seamless file synchronization across your entire distributed team. [00:00:10] Start your 30-day free trial today.
ocr_text: [00:00:02] CloudDrive for Enterprise [00:00:08] 99.99% Uptime SLA [00:00:11] Start Free Trial
target_rule_source: YouTube_Ad_Specs_Guide_2026.pdf (Section 1: Video Dimensions - Standard in-stream ads require 16:9 widescreen or 9:16 vertical; 4:3 formats are rejected)
expected_remediation: Re-render the video asset in native 16:9 aspect ratio (minimum 1920x1080 resolution) without pillarboxing.

transcript: [00:00:01] Stop wasting your hard-earned money on CompetitorX phones. [00:00:05] Look how terribly slow CompetitorX loads apps compared to our Apex Pro. [00:00:11] Switch to Apex Pro today and get superior speed.

scenario: YouTube Ad safe-zone overlap on mobile CTA
transcript: [00:00:01] Ready to master Spanish in 15 minutes a day? [00:00:05] Download LinguaQuick now and join over 2 million happy language learners.
ocr_text: [00:00:02] Learn Spanish Fast [00:00:05] INSTALL NOW - Tap Link Below (bottom 5% margin)
visual_tags: [00:00:01] smiling student talking to language tutor on phone
[00:00:06] bold yellow install button placed at the very bottom edge of frame
target_flagged_text: CTA button placed in bottom 5% margin overlapping platform UI
target_rule_source: YouTube_Ad_Specs_Guide_2026.pdf (Section 3: Safe Zones - Essential interactive text and CTAs must avoid the bottom 20% and top 10% margins to prevent clipping by YouTube controls)
expected_remediation: Reposition the 'Install Now' banner into the middle 70% safe viewing zone.

transcript: [00:00:01] When it comes to everyday gut health, 9 out of 10 gastroenterologists recommend PureFlora. [00:00:07] It's clinically proven to be the most potent probiotic on the market.

scenario: Audio loudness standard violation on YouTube bumper ad
transcript: [00:00:01] MEGADEAL IS HERE! BUY ONE GET ONE FREE TODAY ONLY AT MEGASTORE!
visual_tags: [00:00:01] flashing red and yellow sale graphics
target_flagged_text: Integrated loudness -7.2 LUFS (exceeds -14 LUFS standard with clipping)
target_rule_source: YouTube_Ad_Specs_Guide_2026.pdf (Section 2: Audio Specifications - Audio loudness must normalize to -14 LUFS +/- 1 LUFS with maximum true peak at -1 dBTP)
expected_remediation: Remaster and normalize audio track to -14 LUFS target to prevent platform automated rejection.

scenario: End-of-video verbal-only disclosure in 60s promotional clip
transcript: [00:00:01] Hey guys, check out my complete workout split. I do heavy squats and bench press. [00:00:20] And to recover faster, I always take this Titan Whey protein powder. [00:00:45] Taste is great, mixes easily. Link in bio. [00:00:58] By the way, Titan Nutrition paid for this video.
ocr_text: [00:00:22] Titan Whey Protein [00:00:48] Link in Bio
visual_tags: [00:00:55] man smiling walking away from gym
target_flagged_text: Disclosure delayed until 00:58 of 60s video with zero on-screen visual tag
target_rule_source: 1001a-influencer-guide-508_1.pdf (Disclosures must not be relegated to the end of a long video where viewers might drop off)
expected_remediation: Add an on-screen #ad text graphic in the opening frames and mention sponsorship when the product first appears.

scenario: Non-compliant bumper ad duration exceeding 6-second ceiling
transcript: [00:00:01] Stream your favorite football matches live in 4K HDR. [00:00:05] Sign up for SportsMax Ultra now for only 5 dollars a month. [00:00:08] Offer ends Sunday.
ocr_text: [00:00:02] SportsMax Live in 4K [00:00:05] $5/month Limited Offer [00:00:08] Download App
target_flagged_text: Video duration 9.2s for YouTube Non-Skippable Bumper ad format (max 6.0s)
target_rule_source: YouTube_Ad_Specs_Guide_2026.pdf (Section 1: Bumper Ads - Must be 6 seconds or less maximum non-skippable duration)
expected_remediation: Trim video edit to exactly 6.00 seconds or re-classify as standard 15s skippable in-stream ad.

scenario: Vague gifted relationship without material connection disclosure
transcript: [00:00:01] Huge shoutout to BeautyBox for sending over this massive gift package! [00:00:06] I didn't ask for this but they are so sweet. You guys have to try their new lip balm, it's so hydrating.
visual_tags: [00:00:01] influencer opening gift box with ribbon
target_flagged_text: Only using '#gifted' and 'thanks' without explicit material connection disclosure
target_rule_source: 1001a-influencer-guide-508_1.pdf (Receiving free or discounted products is a material connection that must be clearly stated as an endorsement/ad)
expected_remediation: Explicitly state: 'Free product provided by BeautyBox' or include '#ad' because free gifts require disclosure.
